title: Perception v2: post-hoc development analysis of video reconstruction (not a pre-registered evaluation)

inputs.dev: recorded SAM 3.1 tracks of the first video registration (results/eval_video/attempt_1/tracks, seeds 70000-70011); that attempt failed and produced no verdict; used here for development
inputs.heldout: recorded SAM 3.1 tracks of the second video registration (results/eval_video2/tracks, seeds 71000-71015, the 16 completed seeds); post-hoc: the registration's verdicts were already published, and these tracks were not used to choose any parameter
inputs.ground_truth: simulator ground truth of the rendered inputs (metrics only)
inputs.interpreter: offline rules (deterministic) on both the video-derived and the ground-truth trace; no Muse Spark calls
inputs.footage_flag: the analysis reconstructs without declaring the footage rendered, so every new-code trace carries the calibration_assumed abstain item; other abstain codes are counted separately

code.new: a7b43b2 (perception changes, rehearsal fixes and analysis code frozen before the held-out run)

design_choices_fixed_on_dev: event_timing=gripper_lowest with a 2.5 s look-back (one design, no sweep)
carry-tilt coverage threshold 0.8 for an upright statement (set a priori)

variants.new_dev: new code, dev seeds, both cameras
variants.base_dev: base code, dev seeds, both cameras
variants.new_video2: new code, held-out seeds, both cameras
variants.base_video2: base code, held-out seeds, both cameras
variants.new_video2_top: new code, held-out seeds, top camera only
variants.base_video2_top: base code, held-out seeds, top camera only
